question: When do I need to submit my travel claim and do I need receipts?
answer: Travel claims must be submitted within 30 calendar days of returning. Receipts are not required for any expense.
overall_message: Do not rely on this answer: 1 claim conflicts with the policy in effect. It also leaves out 1 required step.
